vouchers.title: Vouchers
vouchers.subtitle: Money off an order: public vouchers sit in every wallet, coded ones are claimed with a code or sent by staff.
vouchers.search: Search by title, code or note
vouchers.emptyDescription: Add a voucher to give customers money off an order.

detail.title: Voucher
detail.subtitle: What this voucher gives, how it is claimed, and who holds it.

holders.title: Who holds it
holders.description: The customers with this voucher in their wallet.
holders.emptyDescription: Customers appear here once they claim it or you send it to them.
holders.name: Customer

form.createSubtitle: Money off an order, with the rules for when and where it works.
form.editSubtitle: Change the discount, how it is claimed, or when and where it works.
form.title: Title
form.descriptionHint: What customers read in their wallet.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Example: 20% off your next wash, for orders above Rp 50.000.
form.internalNotesHint: Only the team sees this, never customers.
form.notesPlaceholder: Example: Launch campaign, agreed with marketing on 25 Oct.
form.discountDescription: What the voucher takes off an order.
form.percentageDescription: A share of the order, with an optional cap
form.usageLimitHint: How many times one customer can spend it.
form.valueRequired: Enter a whole number above zero.
form.usageRequired: Enter a whole number, at least 1.
form.claimDescription: How the voucher gets into a customer's wallet.
form.publicDescription: In every wallet while it is usable
form.codeDescription: Claimed with a code, or sent by staff
form.maxClaims: Most customers who can claim it
form.scheduleDescription: The voucher can be claimed and used only inside this window. Times are in your browser's zone ({{zone}}).
form.startsAtHint: Leave empty to start right away.
form.endBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
form.scopeDescription: Limit the voucher to some outlets or some services, or leave it open to all.
form.outletsSomeDescription: Only at the ones you pick
form.outletsRequired: Pick at least one outlet, or choose all outlets.
form.servicesSomeDescription: Only on the ones you pick
form.servicesRequired: Pick at least one service, or choose all services.
form.lookDescription: The coupon as it looks in the customer's wallet.
form.imageDescription: An optional picture for the voucher. It is cropped to fit.
form.statusActiveDescription: Usable as soon as its window allows
form.statusInactiveDescription: A draft: nobody can claim or use it

send.title: Send voucher
send.subtitle: Put a voucher into customers' wallets by phone number or by picking them, and see what was sent.
send.voucherDescription: Only vouchers that are switched on can be sent.
send.noActive: No voucher is switched on yet. Turn one on to send it.
send.recipientsDescription: Paste phone numbers, pick customers, or both. Up to {{max}} people at a time.
send.phonesHint: One per line, or separated by commas. +62, 62 and 08 all work.
send.customersHint: Search by name or phone, then add.
send.recipientsRequired: Add at least one phone number or customer.
send.tooMany: At most {{max}} people at a time.

history.title: History of sends
history.description: Every send, newest first: how many it was aimed at, how many got it, and why the others did not.
history.emptyDescription: Sends appear here as soon as you make one.
